A Siemens star of 160 by 160 pixels, blurred with the Gaussian PSF of sigma 2 and the reflect border, with Gaussian noise of sigma 1 from NumPy's default_rng with seed 7. The blurred image has 15.93 dB. The errors are the sum of the absolute differences between the PSF and the true PSF, before and after the default 10 cycles. A narrow first guess barely moves, since the sharp image with a single bright point already fits the photo well. Wider guesses move toward the true PSF.
